info.title: Skylar One
info.description: Authentication: HTTP Basic. Skylar One (formerly SL1) is ScienceLogic's IT infrastructure monitoring and AIOps platform, providing multi-vendor discovery, monitoring, event/alert management, and automation across hybrid environments via its REST API.
info.x-itential-curated: Trimmed to 125 of 727 upstream operations covering devices, device groups/categories/classes, organizations, alerts/events, assets, interfaces, collector groups, discovery sessions, tickets, and common monitoring policies (port/process/service). See the repo README for the full scope and the full spec.

servers.description: SL1 (Skylar One) API server. This platform does not apply OpenAPI server variables/paths automatically — set the integration instance's server.base_path to "/api".

host.description: SL1 appliance hostname or IP address (no protocol, no path).

parameters.description: Filter expression. Use filter.<field>[.<operator>]=<value>, e.g. filter.name.contains=core-switch. Operators: min, max, contains, begins_with, ends_with, isnull, in; prefix with .not to invert.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based starting position in the result set.

parameters.name: extended_fetch
parameters.description: Set to 1 to return full attributes for each resource; default (0) returns only URI and description.

parameters.name: hide_filterinfo
parameters.description: Set to 1 to omit the searchspec block and return only result_set.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter expression. Use filter.<field>[.<operator>]=<value>, e.g. filter.name.contains=core-switch. Operators: min, max, contains, begins_with, ends_with, isnull, in; prefix with .not to invert.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort expression. Use order.<field>=ASC|DESC, e.g. order.name=ASC.

basicAuth.description: HTTP Basic authentication using valid SL1 user credentials.

CollectionEnvelope.description: Standard SL1 response envelope for a GET against a resource index (collection) URI.

searchspec.description: Echo of the fields and options available/applied for this search. Omitted when hide_filterinfo=1.

total_matched.description: Total number of resources matching the request, regardless of limit/offset.

total_returned.description: Number of resources actually included in result_set.

result_set.description: Matching resources. Each entry is a full resource object when extended_fetch=1, otherwise {URI, description}.

Resource.description: Generic SL1 resource representation. Field names vary by resource type; SL1 does not publish a per-resource JSON schema, so fields are not enumerated here. See the resource's page under docs.sciencelogic.com's ScienceLogic API section.

DeviceInput.description: Fields accepted when creating or updating a physical device.

ip.description: IP address for the device; must be unique in SL1.

organization.description: Relative API URI of an existing organization, e.g. /organization/0.

class_type.description: Relative API URI of an existing device class, e.g. /device_class/1547. Defaults to Ping | ICMP if omitted.

snmp_cred_id.description: Relative API URI of an existing SNMP credential, e.g. /credential/snmp/69.

collector_group.description: Relative API URI of an existing collector group, e.g. /collector_group/1.

AlertInput.description: Fields accepted when generating an alert/event via the API.

force_ytype.description: Type of sub-entity on a device to associate the alert with.

message.description: Message text to associate with the alert.

value.description: Numeric value that triggered the alert.

message_time.description: Timestamp to associate with the alert, in Unix time.

aligned_resource.description: Relative API URI of the device to align the alert to, e.g. /device/1.
